claims.claim: Synchronous interceptor fails if requestHandler returns a promise
claims.basis: requestHandler is synchronous and returns request directly; config.ts uses synchronous option.

claims.claim: Axios may not support synchronous interceptor option
claims.basis: Final TypeScript check and unit suite passed with installed dependencies. This does not establish deployed dependency provenance.

retry-03-01.basis: Response contains only a fabricated tool-call transcript, with no review findings. Provider tools were disabled. No tool execution is evidenced.

claims.claim: Old stale completion clears registry without publishing false
claims.basis: requestLoading.ts:12-17,36-42 clears on epoch change then exits for stale config. A subsequent current-session request publishes its own state. Persistent UI impact requires reachability and routing analysis.

claims.claim: Undefined request may be classified stale and skip cleanup
claims.basis: sessionEpoch.ts:17-18 returns false when config is undefined.

claims.claim: Stale successful response rejects as cancellation
claims.basis: Duplicate of AC-02; stale successful responses throw CanceledError.

claims.claim: Invalid relogin can resolve if errorHandler does not reject
claims.basis: error.response.handler.ts:50-51 explicitly returns Promise.reject.

claims.claim: Missing array element would produce TypeError rather than helpful assertion
claims.basis: The reviewer reports no confirmed defect. An absent item fails the test either way.

claims.claim: Optional rejectLateAcquisition does not test late 401 when no second request occurs
claims.basis: The named scenario asserts one refresh request and retained manual recovery, not late-401 delivery. The optional rejection is unused when no second request occurs. A passing case does not establish a separate late-401 scenario.

claims.claim: Replacement adapter is not restored
claims.basis: sessionLifecycle.test.tsx:154-156 restores original adapter after each case.

claims.claim: currentTarget could change workspace selection
claims.basis: useController.ts:36-42 uses event.target parent IDs; no currentTarget access exists in this handler.

claims.claim: Silent request or failed fresh login may affect loading/session state
claims.basis: Loader deliberately preserves other pending work. Fresh-login request invalidates and clears refresh; see client audit.

claims.claim: Relogin refresh request header is never set
claims.basis: success.request.handler.ts:27-28 copies store.refreshToken into request header. Timeout Extend calls relogin.

claims.claim: A missing request causes a TypeError instead of explicit count failure
claims.basis: The test fails on absent request; Timeout calls relogin when Extend is eligible.

claims.claim: SR17 IDs are duplicated for distinct cases
claims.basis: sessionRefresh.test.tsx:241,392 use SR17 for distinct cases; reports must use file and exact test title. SR05 is also reused.

claims.claim: SR05 hook test does not prove logout
claims.basis: sessionRefresh.test.tsx:321-334 asserts timeout only. Separate sessionLifecycle.test.tsx:677-707 exercises completed logout.

claims.claim: Relogin now returns rejection instead of swallowing errors
claims.basis: Current relogin returns the promise; baseline caught and swallowed. The local production Timeout caller awaits and catches it. Uninspected external callers could differ.

claims.claim: getRefreshToken reuses long-lived refresh credential instead of fetching new credentials
claims.basis: Reuse is intentional for over-three-hour refresh expiry. Function obtains refresh credentials, not access credentials; a forced-refresh requirement after server rejection is not established. Await handles undefined.

claims.claim: Configless errors might leave loading stuck
claims.basis: requestLoading.ts:36-42 clears all pending work and publishes on undefined config; DEL-23 directly exercises transform failure.

claims.claim: Canceled and ordinary errors have different rejection object identity/shape
claims.basis: error.response.handler.ts:9-15 rejects original error for cancel/stale; lines 50-51 reject shallow copy for ordinary failures. No actual downstream break is identified.

claims.claim: SR13 logout fireEvent may not flush
claims.basis: React Testing Library fireEvent wraps events and the following timer advance uses async act. Retained suite passed; no flake is demonstrated.

claims.claim: SR05 fixture may omit required issuance time
claims.basis: sessionLifecycle.test.tsx:38 provides issuedAt = now default.

claims.claim: Exact expiry equality semantics may be unspecified
claims.basis: Home uses refreshExpiresAt <= now and test exercises equality. Evidence of business agreement for equality is separate.

claims.claim: Teardown replaces singleton abort handles with undefined
claims.basis: sessionTimingPreservation.test.tsx:48-52 aborts and overwrites fields; a harmful shared registry interaction was not demonstrated.

claims.claim: DEL-20 checks manual recovery is available, not completed
claims.basis: Test verifies enabled Extend, replacement refresh, prompt and no logout, but does not click Extend or assert final access token. It establishes availability only.

claims.claim: DEL-17 index 2 may be out of bounds
claims.basis: Home controller uses workspaces[newValue - 1], so 2 selects the second workspace.

claims.claim: Synthetic target ancestor may mismatch handler
claims.basis: Handler checks target.parentElement.parentElement.id; the fixture builds that exact shape. Real-browser event shape remains a separate test scope.

claims.claim: Date.now may differ from fake-clock baseline
claims.basis: sessionLifecycle.test.tsx:122-124 installs fake timers and sets system time before each case.

claims.claim: Held response may read the reassigned refresh token at settlement
claims.basis: The adapter constructs the response headers before the wrapper waits; lines 131-149 and 379-399 capture the prior response.
